Terms of Use

Last updated: 16 October 2026 [TO CONFIRM: effective date]

1. The agreement

These terms are an agreement between you and MidMightBit Games (Australia) [TO CONFIRM: legal entity name and ABN] (“we”, “us”) for the Yestermanac app (“the app”). By installing or using the app you accept these terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not accept them, do not use the app.

The Yestermanac API, MCP server and Publisher Feed are covered by separate terms. [TO CONFIRM: links to the developer terms and the Publisher Licence].

2. Who can use the app

  • You are 18 or older [TO CONFIRM: minimum age] and can enter into a contract.
  • You are not in a country where the app is unavailable (section 6).
  • You are not on a government sanctions list.

3. Your licence

We give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to install and use the app on a device you own or control, for your own non-commercial use. The app is licensed, not sold.

You may not copy, resell or redistribute the app, reverse-engineer it except where the law allows, remove its notices, or use it to build a competing product.

These limits apply to the app itself. Open content shown in the app, such as Wikipedia text under CC BY-SA 4.0, stays available to you under its own licence. Nothing in these terms limits those rights. See Licences & Attribution.

4. The content

  • Historical texts come from Wikipedia contributors; structured data from Wikidata; pictures from Wikimedia Commons; public holidays from python-holidays. Each entry shows its source.
  • We do not guarantee that content is accurate or complete. Dates before 1582 usually follow the Julian calendar, as on Wikipedia. Holiday dates that depend on a lunar calendar are marked “estimated” and may shift.
  • Some entries concern contested history. The app keeps them in a separate “Sensitive & Disputed” tab, which you can include in your feed or not. We do not take a position on any dispute, and country names follow neutral international standards.
  • You can send a correction from any entry. Please keep reports accurate, lawful and polite.

5. Free, Seeker and Pro

  • The free tier shows one event a day.
  • If the wallet you connect holds a verified Seeker Genesis Token, you get extra free features as shown in the app. A Seeker Genesis Token does not unlock Pro.
  • Pro is a yearly subscription: each payment, in SOL or SKR on the Solana network at the price shown in the app when you pay, gives 365 days of Pro from the time of the payment. If you renew before the year ends, the new year starts when the current one ends. Nothing renews or is charged automatically: you renew by making a new payment.
  • You sign the payment in your own wallet. We never hold your funds or your keys. You pay the Solana network fee.
  • The confirmed transaction on the blockchain is your receipt. “Restore purchase” finds it again with the wallet that paid.
  • The app is not a financial product, and nothing in it is financial advice.

Refunds: except where consumer law gives you a right that cannot be excluded, purchases are final. [TO CONFIRM: refund wording per market].

6. Where the app is available

Because of sanctions and anti-money-laundering rules, the app does not work in these countries: Afghanistan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Burundi, Central African Republic, Chad, Cuba, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Eritrea, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Myanmar, Nicaragua, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen and Zimbabwe. We may update this list. [TO CONFIRM: list reviewed by counsel].

The app checks your country when it starts and before a payment, as described on the Data & Location page. Do not use a VPN or false location to get around this check.
